title: The settings layers' gate_checks run in kbgit.py sync --push and in backlog.py done after the shipped checks, and a failing one refuses naming its command
goal: kg_sync.group_gate(root) runs each argv of gate_checks from the settings layers (group, clone, kb root, user; no shell, from the repository root, a timeout each) after the shipped gate and returns the failures, each naming its argv, its layer and exit code; sync --push refuses the push and done refuses the item on any failure, exit 1, and with no gate_checks set both run as before. git.md (the gate) and backlog.md (Definition of done) say where a group's checks run.

run:
import json,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"gate_checks":[[sys.executable,"-c","raise SystemExit(0)"],[sys.executable,"-c","raise SystemExit(3)"]]}),encoding="utf-8")
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kg_sync
fails=kg_sync.group_gate(str(d))
assert len(fails)==1 and "SystemExit(3)" in str(fails[0]) and "clone" in str(fails[0]), fails
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({}),encoding="utf-8")
assert kg_sync.group_gate(str(d))==[]
